#! ia 1.0

@workspace installed-distributions
  meaning
    says "The exact installed native distribution closure."
    answers "Which distributions and systems are active?"
  composition
    systems [@system agent-composition-system, @system agent-system, @system authoring-system, @system compliance-system, @system governance-system, @system hook-authoring-system, @system learning-system, @system session-system, @system template-system, @system work-system, @system workspace-system]
  relationships
    uses @distribution language-distribution

#! ia 1.0

@schema agent-profile
  lowers to binding
  sections
    must have meaning
    must have composition
    must have execution
    may have invocation
    may have presentation
    may have relationships
    closed
  fields
    must have meaning.says as text
    must have meaning.answers as text
    must have composition.agent as ref
    must have composition.capabilities as list of ref
    may have composition.voice as ref
    may have composition.mandate as ref
    may have composition.delegates as list of ref
    must have execution.role as id
    must have execution.outcomes as id
    must have execution.mandate-contract as id
    may have execution.model-profile as id
    may have execution.limit-steps as number
    may have execution.limit-model-calls as number
    may have execution.limit-operations as number
    may have execution.limit-tokens as number
    may have execution.limit-children as number
    may have execution.limit-depth as number
    may have execution.limit-bytes as number
    may have execution.limit-duration-ms as number
    may have invocation.mode as id in [model, user, delegated, none]
    may have invocation.use-when as text "When a host should hand work to this profile."
    may have invocation.avoid-when as text "Work this profile must not take."
    may have presentation.color as id
    may have execution.effort as id

#! ia 1.0

@system agent-composition-system
  provider "inventarch.local"
  version "3.1.1"
  describes "Public agent-composition-system vocabulary contracts"
  steward @agent public-agent-composition-system-steward
  requires
    - agent-system
    - workspace-system
    - governance-system
    - compliance-system
    - authoring-system
    - template-system
  discriminators
    voice lowers to definition
      category property
      facets [voice]
      schema @schema voice
      artifact-set product-definition
      primitive Attention
      move Synthesis
    agent-profile lowers to binding
      category capability
      facets [agent-profile]
      schema @schema agent-profile
      artifact-set execution
      primitive Decision
      move Execution
    harness lowers to definition
      category boundary
      facets [harness]
      schema @schema harness
      artifact-set execution
      primitive Decision
      move Execution
    capability lowers to definition
      category capability
      facets [capability]
      schema @schema capability
      artifact-set product-definition
      primitive Inference
      move Synthesis
    execution-binding lowers to binding
      category relation
      facets [execution-binding]
      schema @schema execution-binding
      artifact-set execution
      primitive Decision
      move Execution
  edges
    cite * using *
    govern * using *
    enforce * using *
    implement * using *
    require * using *
    use * using *

@agent public-agent-composition-system-steward
  meaning
    says "Accountable owner of agent-composition-system vocabulary, canonical schemas, relationship consent and direct dependencies."
    answers "Who owns the voice, agent-profile, harness, capability and execution-binding words?"
  governance
    applies [voice, agent-profile, harness, capability, execution-binding]

@schema observation
  lowers to definition
  sections
    must have meaning
    must have evidence
    must have interpretation
    must have retention
    may have relationships
    closed
  fields
    must have meaning.says as text
    must have meaning.answers as text
    must have evidence.origin as id
    must have evidence.actor as text
    must have evidence.observed-at as text
    must have evidence.captured-at as text

    must have evidence.locator as text
    must have evidence.revision as text
    must have evidence.bundle as text
    must have evidence.digest as text
    must have evidence.availability as id
    may have evidence.subject as ref "The record the evidence is about, as a typed reference; evidence.locator spells the same subject as text."
    may have evidence.subject-revision as text "The subject's per-record digest when the evidence was taken; readiness compares it with the subject's current digest. evidence.revision is its free-text form."
    may have evidence.snapshot-revision as text "The revision of the snapshot the subject was read from."
    may have evidence.evaluator as text "Who produced the evidence, as a ref identity or <tool>@<version>; evidence.actor is its free-text form."
    may have evidence.move as id in [Observation, Execution, Delegation, Synthesis, Verification]
    may have evidence.verdict as id in [success, refusal, inconclusive]
    may have evidence.implementation as text "The <id>@<version> of the check implementation that produced the evidence; evidence.origin names only its kind."
    may have evidence.target as text "The host id the evidence was produced on; with evidence.implementation it types what evidence.origin names."
    must have interpretation.applies as text
    must have interpretation.limits as text
    must have interpretation.reason as text
    must have interpretation.basis as id
    must have retention.status as id
    may have retention.explanation as text

#! ia 1.0

@primitive Memory
  meaning
    says "Recall and retrieval — bring stored context to bear and gather what is already known. Anchors the orient phase, with Attention."
    answers "Does this step need context or commitments that already exist?"
  data
    order 0
    anchor orient

@primitive Attention
  meaning
    says "Selection and focus — attend to what is salient and narrow the field to what matters now. Anchors the orient phase, with Memory."
    answers "Does this step have to pick, from what is available, what matters now?"
  data
    order 1
    anchor orient

@primitive Inference
  meaning
    says "Computation and derivation — derive a conclusion or an approach from the premises; compute the plan before acting. Anchors the plan phase."
    answers "Does this step reach a conclusion or approach by reasoning from premises?"
  data
    order 2
    anchor plan

@primitive Decision
  meaning
    says "Commitment and choice — commit to one option among the named alternatives and make the call. Anchors the act phase, with Escalation."
    answers "Does this step commit to one option within its own authority?"
  data
    order 3
    anchor act

@primitive Escalation
  meaning
    says "Raising and routing — escalate when a gate blocks or the stakes exceed the local authority, routing the call upward. Anchors the act phase, with Decision."
    answers "Must this step hand the call upward because a gate blocks or the stakes exceed its authority?"
  data
    order 4
    anchor act

@primitive Learning
  meaning
    says "Update and consolidation — write back what the run taught and revise the model from the evidence, so the next loop is better informed. Anchors the learn phase."
    answers "Does this step change what later loops will know, based on what a result showed?"
  data
    order 5
    anchor learn
